name: 39016-longdecode-30ba3b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, one vLLM engine.
architecture: 30B-A3B hybrid decoder in bfloat16: 52 layers of mamba, sparse-MoE and attention, laid out by the checkpoint's own pattern.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, 100 requests, 3600 s safety cap, seed static 39016. The measured window is requests 11-100: the percent cooldown is sized against the safety cap and never fires.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`: 50 prompt tokens and 1000 output tokens per request, min == max == mean on both, temperature 0. The prompt is rendered and tokenized by the engine, so the report shows a prompt count a few tokens above 50.
purpose: A long-form story generator writing thousand-token passages from brief prompts for one user at a time on a single GPU.
launch:
model: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B-BF16
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Pinned: left at `auto` the backend depends on which FlashInfer build happens to be installed.
moe-backend: triton

max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
